instruction: Notify the owner with the exact action, payout, deadline, risk, prepared artifacts and evidence; continue all reversible work meanwhile.

evidence: Automated appointment Portal Scheduler 6 days left Verified I need a small, self-contained application that can secure scarce appointment slots on a specific travel-service portal. The flow is straightforward: I enter one or more target dates in a calendar, hit a Start button, and the tool keeps checking the portal around the clock until it finds an opening or until I press Stop. Core behaviour • The program must store my login details locally (encrypted) and perform an auto-login every cycle. • Each request has to run through an advanced proxy rotator so the portal never sees two consecutive hits from the same IP. • Robust error handling is essential—dropped connections, HTTP errors, unexpected page changes, CAPTCHA, and timeouts should be caught, logged, and retried automatically.
